evidence.title: GitHub - byadityaraj/designmd: Production-grade design context for AI coding workflows.

name: DesignMD
summary: CLI and web tool that measures a real site's design system and streams a portable DESIGN.md for coding agents.
description: DesignMD opens a URL in a headless browser and measures the real visual system — colors from computed styles, typography from the cascade, breakpoints from live @media rules, hover and focus states — then writes a portable DESIGN.md spec. The file drops into Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, Copilot or any LLM chat. Ships as a web app plus an npm CLI for Node 18+, with sample DESIGN.md files for Stripe, Linear, Vercel, Notion, Anthropic, Mercury, Figma and Airbnb.
contains: extracts colors, typography, spacing, breakpoints, motion and interaction states
streams markdown or JSON to stdout for piping
web app plus npm CLI requiring Node 18+
sample DESIGN.md files for Stripe, Linear, Vercel, Notion, Anthropic, Mercury, Figma and Airbnb
free tier: 5 anonymous generations per day
exit codes 0-3 for scripts and agents
